# Idea-to-Reality: Universal Architecture & Anti-Lazy Coding Agent Framework [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Compatibility: Universal](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agents-Antigravity%20%7C%20Cursor%20%7C%20Claude%20Code%20%7C%20Windsurf%20%7C%20Aider-8A2BE2.svg)](#universal-agent-support) [![Architecture: C4 Model](https://img.shields.io/badge/Architecture-C4%20Enterprise-emerald.svg)](https://c4model.com) [![Anti-Lazy AI: Zero Tolerance](https://img.shields.io/badge/Anti--Lazy%20AI-100%25%20Enforced-crimson.svg)](#) > **Transform plain-language ideas into production-grade enterprise software blueprints (C4 Model) and enforce zero-tolerance anti-lazy AI supervision across ANY AI coding agent.** --- ## The Core Philosophy: Ending "Vibe-Coding Collapse" Most AI coding assistants suffer from the **"Demo Trap"**: they quickly generate initial boilerplate, but as a project grows, they suffer from context blindness, invent conflicting abstractions, and defer critical logic to `// TODO: implement later` or TypeScript `any` types. **`idea-to-reality`** provides a universal architectural harness that works across **Google Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Aider, Copilot Workspace, and custom LLM agents**: 1. **Never guess, never code blindly**: The agent conducts a multi-stage, plain-language interview to deeply understand your actual business logic, user journeys, and edge cases. 2. **Deterministic Context Mapping**: Uses AST knowledge graphs (`graphify`) and clean context packs (`repomix`) to avoid hallucinated dependencies and conserve 80%+ tokens. 3. **Deep Open-Source Benchmarking**: Automatically inspects proven, production-grade GitHub repositories in your domain, studying their real schemas (`schema.prisma`, migrations) and architectures before writing a single line of your project. 4. **Exhaustive C4 Documentation**: Synthesizes enterprise-grade visual specs (`docs/architecture/`) before implementation begins. 5. **Zero-Tolerance Anti-Lazy Invariant**: Continuously audits code with `knip`, `biome`, and a relentless AST auditor (`audit.py`) to reject any `// TODO` or `any` shortcuts. --- ## Architectural Lifecycle ```mermaid flowchart TD A["👤 User Shares Raw Idea (Plain Language)"] --> B["🔍 Pre-Coding Context:
Graphify AST Mapping + Repomix"] B --> C["🗣️ Multi-Stage Plain-Language Interview
(Core Purpose, User Journeys, Edge Cases)"] C --> D["🌐 Mandatory Live Web Grounding &
Deep GitHub Open-Source Benchmarking
(Inspect README, schema.prisma, and Architecture)"] D --> E["🏛️ Exhaustive C4 Architecture Suite in docs/architecture/
01_system_context.md
02_component_flow.md
03_sequence_diagrams.md
04_database_erd.md
05_open_source_benchmarks.md
+ roadmap.md"] E --> F{"✋ User Explicit Approval Gate"} F -->|Approved| G["💻 Supervised Implementation Turn"] G --> H["🧹 Post-Coding Quality Gate:
Knip (Dead Code) + Biome (Auto-format) + audit.py"] H -->|100% Clean| I["✅ Production-Ready Enterprise Delivery"] H -->|Violation Detected| G ``` --- ## Universal Agent Support (Use in Any Tool) This framework is completely modular and can be integrated into any modern AI coding environment: ### 1. Google Antigravity (App & IDE) Clone directly into your global Antigravity plugins directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/ShahilRoy/idea-to-reality.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/idea-to-reality ``` *Windows PowerShell:* ```powershell git clone https://github.com/ShahilRoy/idea-to-reality.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\idea-to-reality" ``` ### 2. Cursor IDE Copy the rules into your workspace or global rules: ```bash mkdir -p .cursor/rules cp rules/GEMINI.md .cursor/rules/idea-to-reality.mdc ``` *(Or simply copy the contents of `rules/GEMINI.md` into your `.cursorrules` file).* ### 3. Claude Code / Claude Desktop Append to your project's `CLAUDE.md`: ```bash cat rules/GEMINI.md >> CLAUDE.md ``` ### 4. Windsurf / Codeium Cascade Copy the rules to `.windsurfrules`: ```bash cp rules/GEMINI.md .windsurfrules ``` ### 5. Aider / Generic Terminal Agents Point your agent to the instructions file: ```bash aider --read rules/GEMINI.md ``` --- ## What Inside This Framework? ```text idea-to-reality/ ├── plugin.json # Plugin manifest (for Antigravity / Agent ecosystems) ├── LICENSE # MIT License ├── README.md # Universal Guide & Documentation ├── rules/ │ └── GEMINI.md # Portable non-negotiable rules (Live Web Grounding, GitHub Scouting, Anti-Lazy) └── skills/ ├── idea-to-blueprint/ # The Staff Product Architect & C4 Designer │ └── SKILL.md └── anti-lazy-supervisor/ # Zero-tolerance code quality reviewer & self-healer ├── SKILL.md └── scripts/ ├── audit.py # AST anti-lazy checker (Zero // TODO, zero any types) └── tool_manager.py # Autonomous self-healing & auto-update daemon ``` --- ## How to Use It Open **your favorite AI coding assistant** in any project or empty directory, and simply share your idea: > *"I want to build a platform where college students can upload, browse, and trade study notes with instant previews and Stripe payouts."* The AI agent will automatically: 1. Conduct an architectural interview in your preferred language (English, Bengali, etc.). 2. Deep-dive into relevant open-source repositories to study proven schemas. 3. Select world-class modern defaults: **Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS v4, Shadcn UI, Zustand, TanStack Query v5, Prisma, PostgreSQL (Supabase)**. 4. Output visual C4 Mermaid diagrams in `docs/architecture/`. 5. Request your approval before delivering 100% complete, production-ready code. --- ## Developer Toolchain Synergy The framework automatically orchestrates and self-heals the following developer tools: - **`graphify`**: Local AST knowledge graph mapping. - **`repomix`**: High-density AI context packaging. - **`knip`**: Dead-code, dangling export, and orphaned dependency elimination. - **`biome`**: Sub-millisecond formatting and linter. If any tool is missing or outdated, the included `tool_manager.py` self-heals and updates it autonomously. --- ## License This project is licensed under the **MIT License** - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.
